beats.say: A flash drive found in a corridor is no gift. Never plug it in, hand it to security.
Someone may be watching your screen and keyboard from behind. Look around when you type a password.
Never leave a laptop alone in a car or cafe. It is a thief's easiest prize.
Check your desk before you leave: papers locked away, devices locked, prints collected.

scenes.title: At your desk
scenes.intro: You are at your desk. Decide about a found flash drive, a print job and leaving your seat.

actions.label: Plug it in and look
actions.feedback: The file name is bait for your curiosity. Do not plug in a found flash drive.

actions.label: Hand it to security
actions.feedback: Right. Never plug in a found device, give it to the specialists.

steps.say: Look at the file's real type.

actions.label: Open
actions.feedback: This is not a spreadsheet but a shortcut. Opening it runs a hidden command.

actions.label: Eject the device
actions.feedback: The right call. Eject it without opening anything and hand it to security.

actions.label: I go and collect it now
actions.feedback: Right. Anyone passing a shared printer can read what is left there.

actions.label: I will collect it this evening
actions.feedback: Citizens' data will sit on the printer for hours. Collect prints at once.

title.text: Citizens' data is open on screen

body.text: The computer will lock itself in 15 minutes.

steps.say: You get up to go to the printer.

actions.label: Lock the screen
actions.feedback: Right. The Windows key plus L locks the screen in a second.

actions.label: Leave it, I will be back in two minutes
actions.feedback: Two minutes is enough for someone to read or send the data.

nodes.text: You are working on your work laptop in a cafe. You need to go to the counter for your order.

choices.label: I leave it open, it is only a minute
choices.feedback: A minute is enough to steal it, and an open screen exposes the data.

choices.label: I ask the person at the next table to watch it
choices.feedback: A stranger is not your device's guard. Take the laptop with you.

choices.label: I close the laptop and take it with me
choices.feedback: Correct. The device should always stay with you.

nodes.text: Excuse me, I saw on your screen that you work at the agency. What is your manager's name? I have business there.
nodes.speaker: Man at the next table
nodes.spoken: Excuse me, I saw on your screen that you work at the agency. <breath> What is your manager's name? I have business there.

choices.label: I give my manager's name and extension
choices.feedback: Do not give internal details to a stranger. They become bait for a later call or email.

choices.label: I point him to the reception number on the official site
choices.feedback: Polite and with no internal details, well done. Also keep your screen away from others.

scenes.prompt: You found a flash drive in the corridor. Put the steps in order.

items.label: Do not plug it into any computer
Note where and when you found it
Hand it to the security team
Tell colleagues not to plug in similar drives

scenes.explain: A found device is evidence: hand it in as it is, unopened.

scenes.prompt: Match each situation with the right step.

pairs.left: The laptop is on the car seat
Someone is looking at your screen
pairs.right: Turn the screen away or lock it

pairs.left: Your badge is lying on the desk
pairs.right: Keep it on you at all times

scenes.explain: Anything left unattended is an opportunity for an attacker.

points: Never plug in a found flash drive, hand it to security.
Lock the screen when you get up, collect prints at once.
Never leave laptops or papers unattended.
